text: in/low-stock-supplier-status LANDED as 599f3ae7 (inventory 9/9 and integrity 180/180 green in its copy); the two review documents landed too. HR/salary may come next. The failure matrix is clear and honest, thank you. The boundary question (may an expiry-side AppError park a completed till sale centrally as REJECTED until an admin replays it, or must the sale always post centrally with the expiry part kept as an unallocated exception) is the owner's and has been put to the owner now; do not push in/expiry-sale-transactions until it is answered here. The brain's recommendation to the owner, not yet a decision: the till is never blocked (already true), and the central sale document is never rejected because of the expiry module: every expiry-side AppError becomes an unallocated exception like the stale-approval and budget cases, so stock and money post and nobody has to replay by hand; only technical faults (non-AppError) keep the PENDING retry. Real-data preflight counts: the brain runs your read-only count SQL on the real system only with the owner's consent and only when the migration branch itself is waiting, not before.
